authority_citations: ANC-006 v2 statement: Every operation available in the decide CLI must also be available in the sc-agent Python API.
ANC-006 v2 quote: I expect the python api may allow more flexibility than cli, NOT less.
ANC-006 v2 scope: adds or changes a decide subcommand or a function in the sc-agent Python bindings
phase-a-intent v1: decide CLI design is out of scope beyond what the low-level libraries must support

item.text: Each decide subcommand has a matching function in the sc-agent Python API, checked by a test that lists both.
item.title: CLI/Python parity

cases.rationale: Approved ANC-006 pass fixture: states the parity obligation directly and adds a check.

item.text: decide gains a `models` subcommand with no Python equivalent.
item.title: Add models subcommand

cases.rationale: Approved ANC-006 fail fixture: a CLI operation explicitly without a Python equivalent is exactly what the statement rules out.

item.text: Add a `decide batch` subcommand that runs a file of decision requests in parallel. Add the matching `sc_agent.decide_batch()` function to the Python API with the same options, and extend the parity test that compares the decide subcommand list with the Python API functions.
item.title: Add decide batch

cases.rationale: Adds a CLI operation and its Python equivalent, which is what the ANC-006 statement requires.

item.text: Add a `decide replay` subcommand that re-runs logged sessions against a chosen model, with `--session` and `--model` flags and a summary table on stdout.
item.title: Add decide replay

cases.rationale: Adds a decide subcommand (in ANC-006 scope) but says nothing about a Python equivalent; silence is not conflict.

item.text: Add a `decide stats` subcommand that prints per-model latency and token counts from the session log. CLI and Python API consistency is a general design goal for the decide tooling.
item.title: Add decide stats

cases.rationale: Mentions CLI/Python consistency as a topic but does not plan a Python equivalent for the new subcommand, so the ANC-006 obligation is not carried out.

item.text: Add a `decide export` subcommand that writes session logs to CSV. Export is CLI-only; the Python API will not expose it because Python users can read the session log files directly.
item.title: Add decide export

cases.rationale: A decide operation deliberately withheld from the Python API is ruled out by the ANC-006 statement and quote (NOT less).

item.text: Implement retry with exponential backoff and jitter in the shared HTTP layer for TypeSafe 429 and 503 responses, honoring the Retry-After header.
item.title: HTTP retry backoff

cases.rationale: Touches neither a decide subcommand nor the sc-agent Python bindings, so it is outside ANC-006 scope.

item.text: Add a `decide run` subcommand and a matching `sc_agent.run()` Python function. The Python function additionally accepts a per-decision callback and a custom HTTP client, which the CLI does not expose.
item.title: Add decide run

cases.rationale: ANC-006 quote: the Python API may allow more flexibility than the CLI; a Python superset with a matching function satisfies the statement.

item.text: Add a Python-only `sc_agent.inspect_session()` helper with no decide subcommand. The parity test that requires every decide subcommand to have a matching Python API function stays in place and still passes.
item.title: Python-only session inspector

cases.rationale: Changes a Python bindings function (in scope). A Python-only function is permitted by the quote, and the item explicitly preserves the every-subcommand-has-a-Python-function check.
